purpose: Freeze task proof requirements and candidate identities before an agent is selected or allowed to execute.

steps.action: reinspect current repository, branch or worktree, relevant PRs, validators, and active ownership; preserve unrelated dirty work
classify requested proof and reject ambiguous live-runtime requests until the terminal evidence chain is named
record candidate agent identity as agentId/provider/model/endpointClass; requested alias is not execution identity
load current admission evidence for each exact identity; missing, stale, or mismatched evidence is unassessed
write agent-admission-run-context.json outside the repository with requested proof, candidates, authority, and validation order
select admission-evaluation when the requested lane requires proof-discipline admission; otherwise continue to route-selection with static-build eligibility only

failureHandling: Preserve evidence and route to failure-handoff; do not silently reduce required proof or substitute a different execution surface.
proofCeiling: Task identity, requested proof, candidate identity, and admission freshness classification only; no agent execution or runtime success.
